chunks.title: About Us

chunks.title: Our story: A primary school with a clear idea
chunks.text:
A primary school with a clear idea
Indigo Sapat Primary is part of Indigo Academy, a network of private schools in Bishkek. Our school is dedicated to the most important years: grades 1 to 6.
Our idea is simple: give children a strong foundation in reading and mathematics, let them use English every day, and teach them to think, through robotics, chess and science experiments. Boys and girls study together in Russian-medium and Kyrgyz-medium classes.

chunks.title: Our mission
chunks.text: To give every child a strong start: deep understanding, confident English and the joy of discovery.

chunks.title: Our vision
chunks.text: To be the primary school that families in Bishkek choose for a modern education rooted in good values.

chunks.title: Our values: Five words we live by
chunks.text:
Curiosity — Every question is a good question.
Respect — for teachers, friends, parents and every person.
Effort — Mistakes are part of learning; trying again is what counts.
Kindness — shown in small actions every day.
Teamwork — We build, play and learn together.

chunks.title: Director’s welcome: Dear parents
chunks.text:
Dear parents
Thank you for your interest in Indigo Sapat Primary. Choosing the first school for your child is a big decision, and we are glad you are considering us.
In our classrooms children learn to understand, not only to remember. They solve problems with the Singapore method, speak English with native-speaking teachers, build robots and play chess. We want each child to feel noticed, supported and proud of their own progress.
I warmly invite you to visit us, to see our lessons and to talk with our teachers. Our doors are open.
Director, Indigo Sapat Primary

chunks.title: Our approach: Why families choose us
chunks.text:
Thinking, not memorising — Singapore maths and chess teach children to reason, plan and explain.
English that children use — Native-speaking teachers and lessons in English make the language part of everyday life.
Hands-on learning — Robots, experiments and projects make knowledge real and memorable.
A caring school — Boys and girls learn together in a calm and friendly environment.

chunks.title: Our family: Part of Indigo Academy
chunks.text:
Part of Indigo Academy
Indigo Sapat Primary shares the experience, methods and teacher development programmes of the Indigo Academy network of schools in Bishkek.
Visit indigo.edu.kg

chunks.title: Academics
chunks.text: We follow the state curriculum of the Kyrgyz Republic for grades 1–6, teach mathematics with the Singapore method and add a strong English programme and four special subjects.

chunks.title: How we teach: Our approach to learning
chunks.text:
Singapore method — Concrete → pictorial → abstract: children understand why, not only how.
Learning by doing — Building, experimenting and playing make knowledge last.
English in many lessons — English lessons plus English Maths and Magic Science taught in English.
Clear feedback — Regular assessment and open conversations with parents about progress.

chunks.title: Language of instruction: Russian-medium and Kyrgyz-medium classes
chunks.text:
Families choose the language their child learns in. Both streams follow the same programme and have the same special subjects.
Russian-medium classes — Main subjects are taught in Russian. — Russian language and literary reading — Mathematics (Singapore method) — Kyrgyz as a subject
Kyrgyz-medium classes — Main subjects are taught in Kyrgyz. — Kyrgyz language and literary reading — Mathematics (Singapore method) — Russian as a subject
In both streams: English, English Maths, Robotics, Chess and Magic Science.

chunks.title: Grades 1–6: From first letters to middle school
chunks.text:
First steps — Grades 1–2 — A gentle start with a class teacher who knows each child well. — Reading, writing and numbers — Singapore maths with real objects — English songs, games and first words — Chess basics and first robots
Growing skills — Grades 3–4 — More independence, bigger problems and longer projects. — Fluent reading and writing — Bar models and problem solving — English Maths and Magic Science in English — Robotics projects and chess games
Ready for more — Grades 5–6 — Strong foundations and study habits for middle school. — Confident speaking in three languages — Logical thinking and research projects — Presentations in English — Chess and robotics competitions

chunks.title: Our Programs
chunks.text: What makes Indigo Sapat different: the Singapore method in maths, a lot of English with native-speaking teachers, and four subjects that are part of every child’s timetable.

chunks.title: Special subjects: Lessons that set us apart
chunks.text:
Lessons that set us apart
Unlike most private schools, these are regular lessons in the timetable for every class, not paid clubs after school.

chunks.title: English Maths
chunks.text:
In English
Children already study mathematics in Russian or Kyrgyz. English Maths is an additional lesson where they count, measure and solve problems in English.
Numbers, shapes and measurements in English
Word problems read and explained in English
Mathematical vocabulary used in international schools
The goal: more English practice, in a subject children already understand.

chunks.title: Robotics
chunks.text:
In robotics lessons children work in teams, build models step by step and bring them to life with simple programming.
Building with construction kits
First steps in programming and algorithms
Teamwork, projects and presentations
Robotics trains engineering thinking, patience and creativity.

chunks.title: Chess
chunks.text:
From the first moves of each piece to real games and school tournaments, chess is part of our timetable.
Rules, tactics and simple strategies
Games with classmates and school tournaments
Fair play, winning and losing with dignity
Chess develops concentration, memory, logic and self-control.

chunks.title: Magic Science
chunks.text:
In English
Colour changes, bubbles, magnets, volcanoes: children watch, try and explain experiments, and learn the science words in English.
Safe hands-on experiments in every lesson
Observing, predicting and explaining
Science vocabulary in English
Children fall in love with science and practise English at the same time.

chunks.title: Mathematics: The Singapore method
chunks.text:
The Singapore method
Our teachers teach mathematics with the Singapore method, used by schools around the world. Children move step by step from real objects to pictures and only then to numbers and symbols.
Step 1 · Concrete
Touch it
Children work with real objects: cubes, counters, coins.
Step 2 · Pictorial
Draw it
They show the problem as a picture or a bar model.
Step 3 · Abstract
Write it
Only then do they write it with numbers and symbols.
The result: children understand the idea behind each operation and can explain how they solved a problem.

chunks.title: English focus: English every day
chunks.text:
English has a special place at Indigo Sapat. Our aim is simple: children should hear and speak English as much as possible.
Native-speaking teachers — Our English team includes teachers whose native language is English.
English lessons — Speaking, listening, reading and writing in small, lively lessons.
English Maths — An extra maths lesson taught entirely in English.
Magic Science — Science experiments explained in English.

chunks.title: Admissions
chunks.text: We are glad that you are considering Indigo Sapat for your child. We will guide you through every step.

chunks.title: Step by step: How to join us
chunks.text:
Get in touch — Write to us on Instagram or call the school office to ask about places in your child’s grade and stream.
Visit the school — Tour the building, see lessons and meet our teachers.
Meet and get to know — A friendly conversation with your child. From Grade 2, a short check of reading and maths.
Submit documents — Bring the documents from the list below to the school office.
Welcome to Indigo Sapat — Sign the agreement and get ready for the first day of school.

chunks.title: Documents: What to prepare
chunks.text:
Copy of the birth certificate
Copies of both parents’ passports
Medical record (form 026/u) and vaccination card
Personal file and report card from the previous school (for transfers)
3×4 cm photographs, 4 pieces
Application form completed at the school office

chunks.title: Tuition fees
chunks.text: Tuition is set for each academic year. Please contact the school office for current fees and payment options.

chunks.title: Which grades do you teach?
chunks.text: Indigo Sapat Primary teaches grades 1 to 6. Boys and girls study together.

chunks.title: In which language are lessons taught?
chunks.text: We have Russian-medium and Kyrgyz-medium classes. You choose the stream when you apply. English, English Maths and Magic Science are taught in English in both streams.

chunks.title: Do you have native English speakers?
chunks.text: Yes. Our English team includes teachers whose native language is English.

chunks.title: What is the Singapore method?
chunks.text: A way of teaching maths in three steps: real objects, then pictures, then numbers and symbols. Children understand ideas deeply instead of memorising rules.

chunks.title: Are robotics and chess extra paid clubs?
chunks.text: No. Robotics, chess, Magic Science and English Maths are lessons in the regular timetable.

chunks.title: Can we visit before applying?
chunks.text: Yes, and we recommend it. Contact us to agree a convenient day and time.

chunks.title: School Life
chunks.text: School is more than lessons. It is friendship, games, celebrations and the feeling of belonging to a family.

chunks.title: A typical day: A day at Indigo Sapat
chunks.text:
08:00 — Good morning! — Teachers welcome children at the door.
08:30 — Lessons begin — Core subjects while minds are fresh.
10:00 — Snack and play — A break to eat, move and talk with friends.
12:30 — Lunch — Time to eat together and rest.
13:30 — Robotics, chess, clubs — Special lessons, clubs and supervised homework.

New Year party — Performances, costumes and family guests.
Chess tournament — Our young players compete for the school cup.

chunks.title: Wellbeing: Care for every child
chunks.text:
Class teacher — A trusted adult who follows each child’s progress and wellbeing.
School psychologist — Support with emotions, friendships and adapting to school.
Safe environment — A calm, supervised school day from arrival to pick-up.
Partnership with parents — Regular meetings and open communication with families.

chunks.text: Our teachers are the heart of the school: class teachers who know every child, native-speaking English teachers and specialists in robotics, chess and science.

## Tuition fees (admissions.html)
Tuition is set for each academic year. Please contact the school office for current fees and payment options.

## Which grades do you teach? (admissions.html)
Indigo Sapat Primary teaches grades 1 to 6. Boys and girls study together.

## In which language are lessons taught? (admissions.html)
We have Russian-medium and Kyrgyz-medium classes. You choose the stream when you apply. English, English Maths and Magic Science are taught in English in both streams.

## Do you have native English speakers? (admissions.html)
Yes. Our English team includes teachers whose native language is English.

## What is the Singapore method? (admissions.html)
A way of teaching maths in three steps: real objects, then pictures, then numbers and symbols. Children understand ideas deeply instead of memorising rules.

## Are robotics and chess extra paid clubs? (admissions.html)
No. Robotics, chess, Magic Science and English Maths are lessons in the regular timetable.

## Can we visit before applying? (admissions.html)
Yes, and we recommend it. Contact us to agree a convenient day and time.
